reviewer_note: Read only items-author.json, the 13 workflows/*.yaml contracts and scripts/workflow_registry.py in .worktrees/netzoo-core-p0-run (all read in full); nothing else was opened and the assistant was not run. Each gold was checked against verbatim contract text: required inputs, control ranges and combinations (BONOBO delta < 1/3 with sparsify, DRAGON paired lambdas in [0, 1], OTTER lam in [0, 1], SAMBAR 2 <= kmin <= kmax <= samples, GIRAFFE controls: []), sample minimums (LIONESS/BONOBO >= 3), COBRA genes > samples, and LIONESS-DRAGON value counts recomputed as F(F-1)/2 x samples with F the features of both layers (M01, M08, M23 all confirmed). file_checkable is set only for ask items of form 'run' (M01, M36, M38, M44): true when the contract's input check reads the deciding quantity from the named files before the run (LIONESS-DRAGON value cap, SAMBAR kmax vs mutation samples), false otherwise; null for all other items. One gold changed (M39 workflows); interpretation_facts corrected without a verdict change for M02, M15, M17, M22; borderline items flagged in reason (M20, M36, M47).

M01.deciding_fact: How many CpG features cpg_85.csv holds: 300 probes (600 features, 179,700 pairs x 85 = 15,274,500 values) or 5,000 probes (5,300 features, 14,042,350 pairs x 85 = 1,193,599,750 values).
interpretation_facts: Each sample's network is relative to the 85-sample cohort; RNA and CpG methylation are the two layers
M01.reason: Arithmetic checks: 600 features give 179,700 pairs x 85 = 15,274,500 (allowed); 5,300 give 14,042,350 x 85 = 1,193,599,750 (refused). The value cap is computed from the named layer files before the run, so the input check settles it.
M01.evidence: lioness-dragon.yaml: "The per-sample table holds one value per feature pair per sample; runs above 20,000,000 values are refused before they start."
